gap: Citrus mugs are mostly summer lemons (Amalfi style), single-fruit repeats or flat illustration, often on white. None found mixes the winter citrus (blood orange, clementine, pink grapefruit) with lemons and limes, orange blossom, cinnamon and star anise in layered watercolor on cream, and none offers accent handles in matching citrus colors. Our angle: a dense all-over watercolor wrap with whole fruit, wheels and half-moons, plus Orange, Yellow and Light Green accent mugs.
trend: Citrus prints are a 2026 interiors trend (Living Etc: citrus fruit pattern trend; TheCoolist: lemon kitchens and orange kitchens for 2026; Outfy lists citrus tones among 2026 palette trends). Winter citrus is in season: mandarin and clementine volumes rose this winter (The Packer), and blood oranges peak from mid-December (FreshPlaza). eRank's January snapshot ranks 'mug' #37 among searches.
decision: go (21/25): pattern design 'Winter Citrus', no slogan or name on the art
